description: INSTALLATION OF AIR CONDITIONING TO TWO BEDROOMS IN THE HOUSE .
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Commencement of development (Full Permission) - The development to which this permission relates shall be commenced not later than the expiration of 3 years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - Approved Plans - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: 
Drawing no. 2025 OS 100042766 (Site Location Plan) Dated 01 November 2025 
Drawing no. (Proposed Front Garden Plan, Proposed Front  Elevation Plan , Proposed Rear Elevation Plan And Proposed Plan Shoeing the Minimum Distances Of the  A/C Acoustic  Enclosure Box from the Neighbouring Windows) Dated 01 November 2025 
Design and Access Statement Dated 01/11/2025 
Sound Attenuation - Inverse Square Law Dated 14/10/2025 
Outdoor PANASONIC A/C Unit in the Front Garden And Diaken 
Quiet Box 2 Dated 14/10/2019 
SITE PHOTOGRAPHS Sowing View House From Bradshaw Close , View Of Proposed Location for A/C And Acoustic Enclosure 
Condition : 3 - Materials as Specified - The facing materials to be used for the development hereby permitted shall be those specified in the application form unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - Prior to first use of the A/C Unit hereby permitted, the acoustic enclosure as granted shall be installed and maintained in accordance with the approved plans. The acoustic enclosure shall remain in place unless otherwise first agreed in writing by the local planning authority. 

Reason:  To safeguard the amenities of the occupiers of adjoining properties and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policy D14 of the London Plan 2021 and policy D12.1 of the Local Plan 2024.
Condition : 5 - INFORMATIVE (Party Wall Act) - The applicant is advised to check the requirements of the Party Wall Act 1996 relating to work on an existing wall shared with another property, building on the boundary with a neighbouring property, or excavating near a neighbouring building. Further information is available at the following link: 
https://www.gov.uk/party-walls-building-works
Condition : 6 - INFORMATIVE
Note to Applicant -Approved Schemes
In accordance with paragraph 38 of the National Planning Policy Framework, London Borough of Merton (LBM) takes a positive and proactive approach to the delivery of sustainable development, by:
1. Providing a formal pre-application advice service, details to be found on Planning pre-application advice service on LBM's website
2. Providing written policies and guidance, which is available to view on LBM's website.
3. Where appropriate, negotiating amendments to secure a positive decision.
4. Determining applications in a timely manner including providing a fast track service, details to be found on Get a quicker planning decision on LBM's website.

In this instance:
i) The application was acceptable as submitted, and approved without delay
